decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding Concepción Villafuerte Blanco's spouse. Document 1 (D1S3, D1S9) explicitly states she married 'Princess Wilhelmine, Duchess of Sagan' in 2001. Document 2 (D2S3, D2S16) asserts she was married to 'Amado Avendaño Figueroa' starting in the 1960s. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat audits as fallible, both names are retained as valid answers derived from the source text, despite the contradiction.
